privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Qawam, your privacy is not just a feature — it's a foundational principle. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use the Qawam mobile application.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect the following types of information:

  • Account Information: When you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address, and profile photo. This is used solely for authentication and account identification.
  • Expense Data: You enter expense amounts, categories, notes, and dates. All expense amounts are encrypted locally on your device using AES-256 encryption before being stored or synced.
  • Device Information: We may collect basic device identifiers to generate your unique encryption keys. These keys never leave your device.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content:
• To provide and maintain the Qawam app functionality
  • To authenticate your identity through Google Sign-In
  • To sync your encrypted data across your devices via Firebase Firestore
  • To generate spending statistics and insights displayed only to you

We do not use your data for advertising, profiling, or selling to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Data Encryption & Security
sections.content:
Qawam uses a privacy-first architecture:

  • Expense amounts are encrypted with AES-256 before leaving your device
  • Encryption keys are generated from a device-unique identifier and stored securely using Flutter Secure Storage
  • Even if our cloud servers were compromised, your financial data remains unreadable
  • We cannot decrypt your expense amounts — only your device can

sections.heading: 4. Data Storage
sections.content:
• Local Storage: All data is stored locally using Hive (an encrypted NoSQL database) for offline access and performance
  • Cloud Storage: When sync is enabled, encrypted data is stored in Firebase Firestore. Only encrypted ciphertext is transmitted and stored in the cloud

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Services
sections.content:
Qawam uses the following third-party services:

  • Firebase Authentication — for Google Sign-In
  • Firebase Firestore — for cloud sync of encrypted data

These services are governed by Google's Privacy Policy. We minimize the data shared with these services to only what is necessary for functionality.

sections.heading: 6. Data Retention & Deletion
sections.content:
You have full control over your data:

  • You can delete individual expenses at any time
  • You can delete your entire account and all associated data from the app settings
  • Upon account deletion, all data in Firestore is permanently removed

sections.heading: 7. Children's Privacy
sections.content: Qawam is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with data, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted within the app and on our website. Continued use of Qawam after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: 9. Contact Us
sections.content:
If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: support@qawam.app
